summary: POSCO Holdings Inc. on Form 6-K reports a board resolution (2026-04-17) to acquire new shares in Saffron Resources Private Limited, a subsidiary of JSW, for approximately KRW 1,609.6 billion (~USD 1,093 million), representing a 50% stake in a 50:50 joint venture to build an integrated steel mill in Odisha, India. The acquisition is for cash; no premium or break fee mentioned. The deal is subject to conditions precedent and staged capital contributions through 2031. POSCO's total investment including debt portion is USD 3,644 million, with separate board approval for debt. No advisors named. Watch for regulatory approvals and final share numbers in amended disclosure.
